prompt: As of 2024, at the time of his birth, what was the middle name of the U.S. president who won Alaska, graduated from Yale University, and had a son named Michael?
answer: The president was **Gerald Ford**. He carried **Alaska in the 1976 presidential election**, graduated from **Yale Law School**, and had a son named **Michael**. His middle name at birth was **Rudolph**—his full birth name was **Leslie Lynch King Jr.**; he was later renamed Gerald Rudolph Ford Jr. after his mother’s remarriage.
